dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Low prominence with soft boundary sharpness along the outer edges of the primary/secondary feathers against the darker gray ground.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Relatively distinct horizontal boundary separating the black crown from the blue-gray mantle/nape region.

other_distinctive_markers: High-contrast black trans-ocular stripe with a white supercilium; distinct rufous-orange patch on the posterior flank.
